snippet.title: Mean Bean Tsuu - SHS2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for Mean Bean Tsuu that was shown in SHS2025! This showcases new updates to the Mean Bean engine, including custom stage intro backgrounds and cutscene sprites, restored Lesson Mode, and some of the new cast of characters for the game!

Mean Bean Tsuu is a hack of Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine which aims to be a sequel to the original game, featuring new mechanics from Puyo Puyo Tsuu, as well as a story more in line with that of Japanese Classic Sonic canon. 

Video footage recorded through BlastEm.
Trailer Commentary by Rhomin.
Mean Bean Tsuu is developed by Team Tsuu.

Check out Rhomin's channel here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHSrcQMAmF01G4nohPKRilA

ROM Hack: Mean Bean Tsuu
Source Game: Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine
System: Mega Drive/Genesis
